gen-gf-unkempt-gf-glegoo: Loud, scrappy lettering from Unkempt, stems and curves all cut from one gauge. Glegoo's big counters and wide, unclosed curves give it a refined, editorial pull that the rough heading lacks.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-general-s: Friendly handwriting from Waiting for the Sunrise, with an open-tailed g. Beside it, General Sans holds a steady pressure and smooth bends, tidy against the warmth, agreeable in modest helpings.
gen-indie-flower-space-grotesk: Loose, hand-drawn charm from Indie Flower, letters knotted close. Space Grotesk adds geometric structure, a ribbon of constant width with breathing counters, though the pairing is better kept brief.
gen-almendra-display-gf-arsenal: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut. Arsenal, tight-knit with an x-height near the cap height, can take a slightly larger size beside all that ornament.
gen-almendra-display-gf-genos: Letters that never pinch shut mark Almendra Display, ornate and literary. And Genos presses its glyphs close, with a high midline and a restrained swell, so the ornate heading has a steady partner.
gen-audiowide-gf-martian-mono: Neon-tube strokes, tile-like letters: Audiowide looks built for tomorrow. Martian Mono, a monospace face, brings fixed-width, code-style letters and generous openings, a structured counterweight to the heading's uniform strokes.
gen-audiowide-gf-narnoor: Narnoor tucks short ascenders above big bowls, staying quiet beside Audiowide's futuristic display type with its one-width t. Whole pages of it would glide by without a single snag.
gen-comfortaa-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loop: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped refuses to close its curves. IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped holds clean and still beneath Comfortaa, whose round-pen strokes and stretched spacing are far looser.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B glides around each bend without a snag. Comfortaa's ring-like c and spring-loose spacing stand out boldly, and a shrunken heading would lose some of that neon-tube charm.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian lets its rope-loose curves run free. Comfortaa's neon-tube ring of a c and stretched spacing already sing, so nudge the sans up a little in size to keep up.
